texts.li: {A_nameDef} has had word from {TOWN} ({EVENT}), and has carried it about all day without saying much. The town is having a hard time of it.\n\n{A_nameDef} has come to the council to ask whether the colony could spare {COUNT} {WHAT} for the next courier to take home to {TOWN}.

[tie:marriage] {A_nameDef} married into the colony from {FACTION}, and {A_possessive} people at {TOWN} are in trouble ({EVENT}). The letter that brought it is creased from being read.\n\n{A_nameDef} asks the council for {COUNT} {WHAT} from the stores, to go home with the next courier.

[tie:came] {A_nameDef} came to the colony from {FACTION}, and still has people at {TOWN}. The word from there is bad ({EVENT}), and {A_nameDef} has not slept well since.\n\n{A_nameDef} has asked the council whether {COUNT} {WHAT} could go home with the next courier.

[kind:sickness,medicine] The fever is at {TOWN}, and {A_nameDef} knows people there who will be needing more than prayers. {A_nameDef} has counted what the colony keeps for its own sick and come to the council with a number: {COUNT} {WHAT}, to go with the next courier.

[kind:hunger,food] {TOWN} is going hungry, {A_nameDef} says, and the granary there was thin before it started. {A_nameDef} asks the council for {COUNT} {WHAT} from the stores, carried to the gate for the next courier to take home.

[kind:drought,food] The wells at {TOWN} are low and the fields are worse, by the letter {A_nameDef} has had. {A_nameDef} asks whether the colony could send {COUNT} {WHAT} home with the next courier, to see them through to the rains.
[kind:fire,food] Half of {TOWN} burned, the letter says, and what the fire left is being shared out by the handful. {A_nameDef} asks the council for {COUNT} {WHAT} to go home with the next courier.

li.label: Send {COUNT} {WHAT} home with the courier
li.outcome: The council agrees. {A_nameDef} carries the {WHAT} out to the gate, where a runner of {FACTION} will take it on to {TOWN}.

outcomes.li: [tie:marriage] The council agrees. {A_nameDef} carries the {WHAT} out to the gate and stays to see the runner of {FACTION} load it.
[medicine] The council agrees. {A_nameDef} packs the medicine with care and carries it out to the gate for the runner of {FACTION} to take to {TOWN}.

li.label: The colony can't spare it now
li.outcome: The council says the colony's own stores come first this season. {A_nameDef} nods, and says nothing more about it.
